questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Dipylidium caninum?
options: Egg packets or proglottids in stool or perianal material.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Egg packets or proglottids in stool or perianal material. Inspect packets at 100× and individual embryos near 400×; examine segment morphology when available.
